The '''Skar'kla Consortium''' was a criminal organization which existed shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at which time it was lead by a young [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Akris Ur'etu]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Skar'kla Consortium was taken over by a young [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] named [[Akris Ur'etu]]. Various [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminals attempted to take control of Skar'kla territory while Ur'etu was in control; eventually, one of them hired a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to impersonate a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and harass Skar'kla operations and then kill Ur'etu. To defend himself from what he believed was a Jedi, Ur'etu hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to kill the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Bane however allowed the bounty hunter to kill Ur'etu before defeating him in turn and making a deal to collect the crime lord's bounty himself and be taught how to make the imposter's equipment.<ref name="Rep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skar'kla Consortium first appeared in the short story ''[[Reputation (Cad Bane)|Reputation]]'' which was written by [[Ari Marmell]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 136]] in [[2012]].
